model: PM6-D3H4 Rezac-Hobza H4 hydrogen bonding and short-range H-H repulsion
dispatch: one GPU thread per molecule; molecules are independently batched

inputs.atoms: packed float4 position/radius and uint4 atomic identity

outputs.correctionsEv: float2 H4 and H-H correction energies per molecule

precision: float32 Metal with mandatory float64 CPU parity gate
